scene-1-pad.webp.alt: The team's rocket standing on a grey sheet before launch: off-white nosecone and tubes, the orange switchband, and four fins at the base.
scene-1-pad.webp.caption: On the pad

scene-2-apogee.webp.alt: After apogee: the drogue parachute is open, the rest of the rocket hangs nose-down on the shorter cord and the booster hangs on the longer cord beside it.
scene-2-apogee.webp.caption: After apogee: drogue open

scene-3-600ft.webp.alt: Below 500 ft: the payload and nosecone hang under the payload parachute on the left; the middle body, the drogue and the booster hang under the main parachute on the right.
scene-3-600ft.webp.caption: Below 500 ft: main and payload parachutes open

scene-4-landing.webp.alt: Landing on the grey sheet: the payload and nosecone lie beside the flattened payload parachute, and the booster touches down under the main parachute.
scene-4-landing.webp.caption: Landing

robot-build.webp.alt: The finished robot on a lab bench: tracked drive base, ultrasonic sensors, and the 3D-printed frame carrying the control boards.
robot-build.webp.caption: Competition robot, final build

robot-housing.webp.alt: SolidWorks model of the printed chassis frame: vertical column posts, angled braces, and two circular lightening cutouts through the front sensor panel.
robot-housing.webp.caption: Main housing, SolidWorks model

robot-assembly.webp.alt: Full robot assembly in SolidWorks: five ultrasonic sensors across the front, control boards on the vertical columns, and the ArUco marker panel raised above them.
robot-assembly.webp.caption: Sensor array and raised ArUco marker panel

plant-wiring.webp.alt: Bench wiring: capacitive soil moisture sensor, DHT11 temperature and humidity sensor and a photocell on a breadboard, all wired to an ESP32.
plant-wiring.webp.caption: Wiring: moisture sensor, DHT11, photocell, ESP32

plant-final.webp.alt: The same enclosure from the front, with the motor controller, ESP32 and breadboard each seated in their own slot on the rear shelf.
plant-final.webp.caption: Every board in its own slot on the rear shelf

coach-demo.mp4.alt: Screen recording of the coach view, which can switch between athletes and edit prescribed workouts.
coach-demo.mp4.caption: Coach view

athlete-demo.mp4.alt: Screen recording of the athlete view, which sees only its own rows and can log against a workout but not change it.
athlete-demo.mp4.caption: Athlete view
